title: RAG
content: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines information retrieved from an external collection with a model’s generation of an answer.

meta.why: The answer depends on both the retrieved material and the generated explanation. Check each one.
meta.example: An assistant retrieves a delivery-policy document, then uses that document to answer a customer’s question.
meta.check: When evaluating a RAG answer, inspect which material was retrieved as well as what the system wrote.
meta.limitation: A RAG answer is only as accurate as the collection behind it, which may be outdated, incomplete, or poorly matched to the question.
meta.sources: Lewis et al.: Retrieval-Augmented Generation | https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401 | Research paper
